prohibited.name: Bithionol
prohibited.reason: Potent photosensitizer causing severe skin reactions
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited in all cosmetic products (21 CFR 700.11)

prohibited.name: Hexachlorophene
prohibited.reason: Neurotoxic; causes brain damage at high exposure
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited in OTC cosmetics; prescription only (21 CFR 700.14)

prohibited.name: Mercury
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited except as preservative in eye cosmetics ≤65 ppm (21 CFR 700.13)

prohibited.name: Phenyl mercuric acetate
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited except as preservative in eye cosmetics ≤65 ppm (21 CFR 700.13)

prohibited.name: Thimerosal
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited except as preservative in eye cosmetics ≤65 ppm (21 CFR 700.13)

prohibited.name: Vinyl chloride
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited as aerosol propellant in cosmetics (21 CFR 700.16)

prohibited.name: Zirconium
prohibited.reason: Causes lung granulomas and skin reactions in aerosol form
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited in aerosol cosmetic products (21 CFR 700.17)

prohibited.name: Lead acetate
prohibited.reason: Lead compound — neurotoxin and developmental toxicant
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited in hair dyes (FDA final rule 2018)

prohibited.name: Aminophenol
prohibited.reason: Sensitizer; potential carcinogen at high concentrations
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited in hair dye products unless within strict concentration limits

prohibited.name: Chlorofluorocarbon
prohibited.restriction_detail: Prohibited as cosmetic aerosol propellant (21 CFR 700.23)

restricted.name: Hydroquinone
restricted.reason: Potential carcinogen at high concentrations; not approved for OTC skin lightening
restricted.restriction_detail: OTC use >2% requires Rx in US. Banned in EU for consumer cosmetics. FDA removed from OTC monograph.

restricted.name: Formaldehyde
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 0.2% as preservative (EU/US guidance). Prohibited in aerosols. Labeling required.

restricted.name: DMDM Hydantoin
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 0.6% (releases formaldehyde). Subject to increasing regulatory scrutiny.

restricted.name: Quaternium-15
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 0.2% equivalent formaldehyde release. Restricted in many markets.

restricted.name: Diazolidinyl Urea
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 0.5% (as formaldehyde releaser). Requires labeling of formaldehyde release.

restricted.name: Imidazolidinyl Urea
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 0.6% as preservative. Restricted concentration limits.

restricted.name: Bronopol
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 0.1% (rinse-off), 0.02% (leave-on). Banned in EU leave-on products.

restricted.name: Retinol
restricted.restriction_detail: FDA advising max 0.3% (leave-on) / 0.3% (rinse-off). Prescription-strength retinoic acid is Rx-only.

restricted.name: Tretinoin
restricted.restriction_detail: Prescription only in US. Prohibited in OTC cosmetics.

restricted.name: Coal tar
restricted.restriction_detail: Permitted in OTC dandruff/psoriasis shampoos at 0.5–5%. Warning label required. Banned in EU cosmetics.

restricted.name: Resorcinol
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 0.5% (rinse-off) in OTC products. Restricted in leave-on cosmetics.

restricted.name: Oxybenzone
restricted.reason: Endocrine disruptor; environmental harm to coral reefs
restricted.restriction_detail: Banned in Hawaii and Palau reef-protection laws. FDA requesting additional safety data (2019 proposal).

restricted.name: Benzophenone-3
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 6% in EU. Under FDA safety review for sunscreen ingredients.

restricted.name: Homosalate
restricted.restriction_detail: FDA requesting additional safety data. Max 15% in EU.

restricted.name: Octisalate
restricted.reason: Potential hormone disruption; systemic absorption detected
restricted.restriction_detail: Under FDA Category III review for sunscreen ingredients.

restricted.name: Octinoxate
restricted.restriction_detail: Banned in Hawaii. Max 10% in EU. Under FDA safety review.

restricted.name: Kojic acid
restricted.reason: Potential carcinogen at high concentrations; skin sensitizer
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 1% in Japan (restricted). EU safety assessment ongoing. No current FDA limit but monitor.

restricted.name: Parabens
restricted.restriction_detail: Propyl/butyl paraben banned in EU leave-on products for children under 3. Total paraben ≤0.8% (EU).

restricted.name: Propylparaben
restricted.restriction_detail: Banned in EU for leave-on products for children under 3. Max 0.14% each or 0.8% mixed.

restricted.name: Butylparaben
restricted.restriction_detail: Banned in EU for leave-on products for children under 3. Max 0.14% each or 0.8% mixed.

restricted.name: Phthalates
restricted.restriction_detail: DBP, DEHP, BBP banned in EU toys/childcare. California Prop 65 listed. FDA monitoring.

restricted.name: Dibutyl phthalate
restricted.restriction_detail: Banned in EU nail products. California Prop 65. Restricted in cosmetics in multiple jurisdictions.

restricted.name: Talc
restricted.restriction_detail: Must be asbestos-free (FDA guidance). Restricted in baby powder; several recalls issued.

restricted.name: Hydrogen peroxide
restricted.reason: Oxidizer; mucosal irritant at high concentrations
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 12% (hair products), 6% (teeth), 3% (general cosmetics).

restricted.name: p-Phenylenediamine
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 2% (oxidative hair dye). Warning label required. Patch test recommended.

restricted.name: Silver
restricted.reason: Accumulates in body (argyria); antimicrobial resistance concern
restricted.restriction_detail: No approved OTC use in cosmetics; EPA regulates nano-silver as a pesticide.

restricted.name: Aluminum compounds
restricted.reason: Neurotoxicity concern at high systemic exposure
restricted.restriction_detail: Max 10.6% (rinse-off), 6.25% (deodorant sticks) per SCCS. FDA reviewing.
